metadata.description: Opsphere — DevOps and SRE intelligence for Cursor. Remote MCP gateway for observability, incident response, CI/CD diagnostics, and cloud operations.

plugins.name: Opsphere MCP Plugin
plugins.description: DevOps & SRE intelligence for Cursor: search Datadog logs and errors, triage site-down incidents, diagnose GitHub Actions and Bitbucket pipelines, check Vercel and multi-platform deployment status, run DNS/HTTP/TLS health checks, and manage AWS, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Cloudflare, Jira, and Sentry from the IDE. Secure remote MCP gateway with OAuth2; bundled skills and subagents for outage triage, CI investigation, endpoint health, and post-mortems. Free Community trial.
